quarterly_data.signal: 10-Q backlog detail: as of June 30, 2026 remaining performance obligations and backlog represent increases of 41.2% and 21.5% relative to December 31, 2025, with approximately 70% of remaining performance obligations expected to be recognized as revenue within the following 12 months. Electric segment backlog was $43,790,038 thousand in total, of which $26,680,344 thousand is expected within 12 months. MSAs accounted for 33% of estimated 12-month backlog and 41% of total backlog as of June 30, 2026. Quanta attributes the increases partly to 2026 acquisitions and partly to additional awards and increased volume with existing customers.
quarterly_data.figure: RPO +41.2% and backlog +21.5% vs December 31, 2025; approximately 70% of RPO expected within 12 months; Electric backlog $43,790,038 thousand ($26,680,344 thousand within 12 months) as of June 30, 2026; MSAs 33% of 12-month and 41% of total backlog

quarterly_data.signal: 10-Q capex: net cash used in investing activities in the six months ended June 30, 2026 included $451.0 million of capital expenditures (versus $273.1 million a year earlier). Quanta expects substantial capital expenditures and commitments for equipment and certain strategic manufacturing facility expansions to be needed for the foreseeable future to meet anticipated demand.
